summary_oneline: Add named namespaces to wikitoolkit via a FederatedWikiStore (ns::id, explicit + broadcast routing) reusing the existing BaseWikiStore contract, merge helpers and single-store tool/MCP bindings.

localization.role: single-store read resolver (--store/WIKI_STORE) — becomes the federation entry point
factory used to open each namespace
write-first open with _migrate; read-only ladder to expose as explicit flag
per-group min-max + weight + dedup merge reused for broadcast
id-prefix parsing that must skip a leading ns::
repo-relative ids that collide across namespaces
config model gaining namespaces + global registry loader
tool inputs gaining optional namespace; factory bound to one store

constraints.statement: Every consumer talks only to BaseWikiStore; a federated implementation must satisfy all 15 abstract methods (or raise NotImplementedError explicitly for lint/dump ones)
constraints.implication: federation.py must be a full BaseWikiStore, not a search-only helper

constraints.statement: SQLiteWikiStore opens write-first and runs _migrate; read-only is only an error fallback
constraints.implication: an explicit read_only constructor flag is required so foreign namespaces are never migrated/mutated

constraints.statement: Raw FTS scores are -bm25 and corpus-relative; callers normalise
constraints.implication: broadcast must min-max per namespace before merging (reuse _apply_weight / _normalize_scores)

constraints.statement: concept_id is repo-relative (file:/dir:) and collides across repos; only _ID_PREFIX_RE and cli._prune_removed parse prefixes
constraints.implication: ns:: prefixing at the federation boundary is safe; _ID_PREFIX_RE must tolerate a leading <ns>::

constraints.statement: project.py must stay stdlib+pydantic for the PreToolUse hook
constraints.implication: WikiNamespaceConfig and the ~/.parrot/wikis.json loader must not import store/search modules

constraints.statement: --path-scoped invocations must never be redirected by ambient env (existing test)
constraints.implication: namespace resolution must keep the --store > --path > env precedence and add --ns on top

constraints.statement: MultiStoreSearchToolkit (FEAT-379) already federates origin kinds at the agent level with origin attribution
constraints.implication: stay at the wikitoolkit/store level; do not duplicate agent-level origin merging; ParrotWikiOrigin can later wrap a federated store

constraints.statement: FEAT-449 uses GraphIndex namespaces named legal:core / legal:civil
constraints.implication: namespace names must allow ':' inside them (hence '::' separator) so a wiki namespace can mirror a GraphIndex namespace name

constraints.statement: Recent wiki commits do not touch resolution/ids/merge code
constraints.implication: low conflict risk; rebase over b5893f4e4 cli.py changes only

new.role: {name: store} + local name; reads fan out (asyncio.gather), ids prefixed ns::, merge via per-namespace min-max + dedup; get_page/neighbors route by prefix (unprefixed → local); writes delegate to local only; stats per namespace; unbuilt/unreachable namespaces skipped with a note
merged map (repo overrides global) → opened read-only stores

new.item: cli.py — --ns option on query/page/related/status; `wikitoolkit ns list|add|remove`
new.role: explicit + broadcast routing; `ns add --global` writes the user registry

new.item: tools.py — optional namespace field on WikiQueryInput/WikiPageInput/WikiRelatedInput; wiki_status lists namespaces

new.role: id round-trip, merge, write routing, read-only guarantee, skip-on-missing, precedence

modified.change: return FederatedWikiStore when namespaces resolve (and --store not given); accept ns selector
add read_only: bool flag routing straight to _connect_readonly and skipping mkdir/_migrate
strip optional leading <ns>:: before kind prefix
open namespaces and inject federated store at the create_wiki_store/create_wiki_tools call
optional namespace argument threaded to the federated store
per-namespace block (plane stats + staleness where a SourceCollectionManager is available)
OPTIONAL: accept an injected federated store and enumerate namespaces; otherwise untouched

untouched: repo_scan.py id builders and the build/upsert/ingest pipelines (each namespace is built by its own project)
Cross-namespace edges and federated writes — v2 follow-up

patterns.pattern: _resolve_read_store precedence (--store > --path > env > project) with ClickException on missing store
create_wiki_store backend switch with lazy backend imports
CliRunner tests building temp repos with build then query/page/related --store
Graceful per-origin degradation (log + note, never fail the whole search) from MultiStoreSearchToolkit

risks.impact: silent schema drift in a sibling repo
risks.mitigation: explicit read_only flag + test that asserts no write/migration

risks.risk: Large planes (ai-parrot wiki.db ≈311 MB) × N namespaces per query
risks.mitigation: SQLite opens lazily; gather concurrently; limit per-namespace top_k; WAL read-only

Global registry loader pulling heavy imports into the hook path
risks.mitigation: keep loader stdlib+pydantic; open stores only in cli/mcp
per-namespace timeout + skip with note (initialize() eagerly, like --backend arangodb path)

unknowns.question: How do entries reach the global registry ~/.parrot/wikis.json — only via explicit `wikitoolkit ns add --global`, or should `wikitoolkit build` self-register every built project?
plausible_answers: manual only (`ns add --global`) — explicit, no surprises (recommended for v1)
build self-registers under its wiki_name, `ns add` for non-repo brains

unknowns.question: Is `remember/note/link --ns <foreign>` allowed in v1 (opens that namespace read-write), or are writes to non-local namespaces refused?
plausible_answers: refuse in v1 — writes always local; foreign stores opened read-only (recommended)
allow with an explicit --ns, opening that single store read-write

unknowns.question: In broadcast output, should the local namespace's ids stay unprefixed (file:x) while foreign ones carry ns:: — or should every id be prefixed uniformly when namespaces are configured?
plausible_answers: local unprefixed, foreign prefixed — keeps existing CLAUDE.md/hook examples valid (recommended)
uniform prefix for all when ≥1 namespace is configured

recommended_next_command.rationale: Localization and reuse points are high-confidence, the three architectural decisions are already fixed by the user, and the remaining unknowns have safe defaults — no fork left to brainstorm.

meta.notes: F016 backs the v2 follow-up only. Unknowns U1-U3 each carry a recommended default so /sdd-spec can proceed without blocking.
